automationNotes: Doc: [**Installing your App via Developer Hub**](https://www.contentstack.com/docs/developers/developer-hub/installing-your-app-via-developer-hub) — verifies **Install App** in the **Top Bar** (**top-right** per doc), completes **Stack App** overlay (`data/dom/Developer-Hub/authorization-window.html`): pick **DEFAULT_STACK**, accept Marketplace terms, **Install**, then **[Configuring an App](https://www.contentstack.com/docs/developers/developer-hub/configuring-an-app)** placeholders + **Save**. Uses first listing row from **Developer Hub doc open any app** — must be a disposable **Stack App** you can reinstall (uninstall first if «once per stack» blocks). Org-only apps omit stack select → flow errors with a deliberate message.
